cards.SF002-034: "A root does not ask which branch it saves." — Asha
cards.SF002-035: "Do not count the ashes. Count what takes root." — Asha
cards.SF002-036: "Leave the hollow open. Someone else may need it." — Asha
cards.SF002-037: "The thorn is there so the blossom may remain gentle." — Asha
cards.SF002-038: "Stone remembers every forest it was asked to bury." — Asha
cards.SF002-039: "Four for the earth. One for the promise we have not made." — Asha
cards.SF002-040: "The wound is where we begin, not where we belong." — Asha
cards.SF002-041: "He has never sworn an oath. He has simply never left." — Asha
cards.SF002-042: "I cannot promise another spring. I can promise to plant." — Asha
cards.SF002-043: "A forest is not one voice. Listen to how it disagrees." — Asha
cards.SF002-077: "Give a promise weight enough, and even stone must answer." — Korr
cards.SF002-078: "Some messages reach their destination only as ash." — Korr
cards.SF002-079: "A crown that cannot warm two strangers is scrap." — Korr
cards.SF002-080: "The first strike ends a duel. The second begins a feud." — Korr
cards.SF002-081: "We kept one kiln for work that could not wait for miracles." — Korr
cards.SF002-082: "Not every seal deserves to hold. Learn the difference first." — Korr
cards.SF002-083: "Repair the plate. Leave the scar. We need the reminder." — Korr
cards.SF002-084: "An ember is a fire that has learned what it is guarding." — Korr
cards.SF002-085: "I will not call this fire obedient. I will call it mine to answer for." — Korr
cards.SF002-086: "It was not sleeping. It was waiting to be asked." — Korr
cards.SF002-120: "A reflection must be allowed to leave." — Neris
cards.SF002-121: "The sea keeps no clocks. It remembers the waiting." — Neris
cards.SF002-122: "A memory shared is not a memory surrendered." — Neris
cards.SF002-123: "Someone must hold the line while the small ones rise." — Neris
cards.SF002-124: "Stillness is sometimes only a storm with excellent manners." — Neris
cards.SF002-125: "The city is gone. The sea has not agreed." — Neris
cards.SF002-126: "Let the water return. Leave the drowning behind." — Neris
cards.SF002-127: "A custodian keeps the memory. It does not own the grief." — Neris
cards.SF002-128: "I will come back. You must remain free to let me." — Neris
cards.SF002-129: "We searched the bottom for an ending. There was another sea." — Neris
cards.SF002-163: "An oath worth keeping leaves room for the next voice." — Seren
cards.SF002-164: "A blade may fall from heaven and still need a reason." — Seren
cards.SF002-165: "No lock is a verdict. Bring me the key." — Seren
cards.SF002-166: "The first light belongs to whoever has waited longest." — Seren
cards.SF002-167: "Five bells. Five answers. No voice above the others." — Seren
cards.SF002-168: "The gate stands because those behind it may leave." — Seren
cards.SF002-169: "Dawn does not deny the night. It gives us somewhere to carry it." — Seren
cards.SF002-170: "A wall is only as honest as the door it protects." — Seren
cards.SF002-171: "I will carry the light. I will not decide where you must look." — Seren
cards.SF002-172: "For once, the morning waited until we were ready." — Seren
cards.SF002-206: "You may keep the promise. You may not keep the person." — Veyra
cards.SF002-207: "Even an ending can leave someone less alone." — Veyra
cards.SF002-208: "There are truths the archive cannot hold without a living hand." — Veyra
cards.SF002-209: "Mercy is not the absence of a blade. It is knowing when to lower it." — Veyra
cards.SF002-210: "Leave it empty. We have mistaken enough chairs for answers." — Veyra
cards.SF002-211: "The last bell is for the one who stayed to ring it." — Veyra
cards.SF002-212: "A veil should shelter a face, never erase one." — Veyra
cards.SF002-213: "Keep one page unwritten. Someone may yet change their mind." — Veyra
cards.SF002-214: "Some things are kept whole by not being spoken for." — Veyra
cards.SF002-215: "The night promised nothing about dawn. Only that it would keep the lamps." — Veyra
